name: postman
description: Connect Postman to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Postman MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Postman to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with aPI collections and workspaces using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Postman workspace.
Find anything in Postman that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review aPI collections and workspaces in Postman.
